segments.text: Hello everyone, and welcome back to EquiTips.
For anyone who is new, thank you for joining us today.
segments.zh: 对于新朋友，感谢你们今天的收看。

segments.text: My name is Ava Kasper, and today I'll be talking to you all about Emerson Cash Valve.
segments.zh: 我叫 Ava Kasper，今天我要给大家介绍 Emerson Cash Valve。

segments.text: Emerson was founded in 1890 in St. Louis, Missouri.
segments.zh: Emerson 于 1890 年在密苏里州圣路易斯创立。

segments.text: Emerson has now evolved into a powerhouse for pressure regulators and back pressure valves.
segments.zh: 如今 Emerson 已经发展成为减压阀和背压阀领域的一大巨头。

segments.text: Now let's dive into the tips and characteristics that makes Emerson so different.
segments.zh: 现在我们来深入了解一下让 Emerson 与众不同的要点和特性。

segments.text: Their regulators handle high flow rates that are well beyond the limitations of others.
segments.zh: 他们的减压阀能处理很高的流量，远远超出其他产品的极限。

segments.text: Most of their cryogenic lines are rated for both cryogenic liquid and gas service.
segments.zh: 他们的低温产品线大多同时适用于低温液体和气体工况。

segments.text: Some of their regulators have internal strainers that protects its working parts and is easily
segments.zh: 他们的一些减压阀带有内置过滤器，可以保护工作部件，而且很容易

segments.text: Lastly, what makes them so different from the others is their wide ranges of sizes.
segments.zh: 最后，让他们与其他品牌不同的是尺寸范围很广。

segments.text: They range from a quarter inch all the way up to two inch, which complements the diverse
segments.zh: 从四分之一英寸一直到两英寸，与为这些应用设计的

segments.text: spring range options designed for these applications.
segments.zh: 多种弹簧范围选项相辅相成。

segments.text: That's all I have for you today.
Please see our email and phone number below for any further questions or comments.
segments.zh: 如有任何其他问题或意见，请查看下方我们的邮箱和电话号码。

segments.text: Thank you all for listening, and I will see you all next month for the next EquiTips.
segments.zh: 感谢大家的收听，下个月下一期 EquiTips 再见。
